Senior Android Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer to own our mobile platform end to end. Requirements: 5+ years of Android development, deep Kotlin and Jetpack Compose experience, Coroutines and Flow, MVVM/MVI architecture, Room persistence with schema migrations, a background service or location pipeline, and experience mentoring engineers or leading a small team. Bonus: crash reduction work, CI/CD pipelines, Kotlin Multiplatform.
